aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:857.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! A Brief Overview The Box Office Manager will be responsible for ensuring that the ticket office runs efficiently through proper training, event management, leadership, and the oversight of day-to-day functions. The Box Office Manager will share the responsibility of maintaining strong relationships between various promoters (internal and external), artist representatives, venue management, and staff members. The position assists in the overall administrative planning, direction, and policy implementation within the department. What you will do • Build and maintain promotional event ticketing system. Manage seating inventory from build of event through settlement of event with a strong emphasis on delegation to staff. • Managing box office via staffing and scheduling. Hire, train and empower staff to ensure that ticketing personnel is following all departmental guidelines and practices. • Either directly or via delegation creates events with appropriate ticketing software. Ensure accuracy, timely response to needs, and follow through with General Manager, Talent Buyers, and Rental Clients. • Ensure equipment is working appropriately and verify correct ticket sales. Update ticket and show related information in internal software. • Maintain continuous rapport between artist management and venue for ticket needs and ticket sales. Attend production promotion meetings and work with booking department members to program their events correctly. • Lead staff in proper Customer Service Policies including resolving customer (internal and external) issues and interfacing with other departments. Assures consistent, courteous, respectful and timely service. • Prepare and provide pertinent reports to the finance department, all other departments as necessary and other third parties or partners on a need to know basis on event settlement reports and ticket counts, with strong emphasis on training and communication on internal ticketing and communication programs. • Run a production department meeting when events go on sale. Will review seating diagram and production to ensure all departments and artist agree with layout and mapping. Education Qualifications • High School Diploma or its equivalency (BA/BS Degree Preferred) Experience Qualifications • 4-6 years Of related work experience • Prior supervisory experience required • Previous experience in the music industry and event planning • Experience with ticketing systems and basic knowledge of databases Skills and Abilities • Advanced knowledge of computerized ticket sales, preferably the Ticketmaster system • Strong math aptitude and with a focus on detail and accuracy • Computer savvy. Knowledgeable and skilled in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Outlook) • Strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills • Strong time management and customer service skills. • Strong attention to detail and moderate to complex problem solving skills • Able

jobgether-jobgether:lever:2d1ca774-0d75-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Developer Enablement Engineer based in India. This role sits at the intersection of AI engineering, developer experience, and platform enablement. You’ll design and build internal AI-powered tooling that helps developers automate remediation, modernization, and migration workflows. The position combines hands-on software development with the deployment and integration of LLM-based assistants, code analysis agents, and AI-enabled CI/CD capabilities. You’ll become a trusted technical resource for developers, troubleshooting issues and helping teams adopt AI-assisted development effectively. Success will be measured through tangible improvements such as faster upgrade cycles, reduced manual effort, and lower operational costs. You’ll work collaboratively across engineering teams in an environment focused on practical AI adoption, continuous improvement, and developer productivity. Design, develop, and maintain internal AI-powered tooling that supports automated remediation, migration, and modernization workflows across developer platforms. Build and integrate AI solutions, including LLM-based assistants, code analysis agents, and AI-enabled tools within existing developer workflows. Integrate AI capabilities into build processes, upgrade cycles, security patching workflows, and CI/CD pipelines. Serve as a subject matter expert and first point of support for developers encountering issues with AI-enabled development tools. Troubleshoot technical issues across AI tooling, developer workflows, and supporting infrastructure, providing timely and practical solutions. Collaborate with engineering teams to identify opportunities where AI can improve development efficiency, automation, and software maintenance. Build new tools from the ground up while also configuring, deploying, and optimizing existing AI platforms and services. Monitor adoption and measure the business and engineering impact of AI initiatives, including faster upgrades, reduced remediation effort, and cost avoidance. Gather developer feedback and analyze usage patterns to continuously improve internal tooling, usability, reliability, and effectiveness. Contribute to a culture of experimentation and knowledge sharing around AI-assisted software development. Requirements: Strong proficiency in Go (Golang) and the ability to build reliable production-quality tooling. Hands-on experience building, integrating, or deploying AI/LLM-powered tools, such as solutions using OpenAI APIs, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or comparable technologies. Practical understanding of developer workflows, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and software development processes. Comfortable working with Linux CLI and/or Windows-based development environments. Ability to design and build new tooling from scratch as well as configure and deploy existing AI platforms and developer tools. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the confidence to act as a go-to technical resource when systems or tools fail. Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, platform teams, and other technical stakeholders. Strong communication skills and an ability to explain technical concepts clearly to different audiences. Experience with security remediation, dependency management, or legacy code modernization is a plus. Familiarity with platform engineering and internal developer platform (IDP) concepts is desirable. A practical, curious mindset and enthusiasm for applying emerging AI technologies to real-world engineering challenges. Benefits: Full-time opportunity with flexible location options across India, including remote work. Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance coverage. Retirement savings plans and access to a discounted employee stock purchase program. Paid time off, holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days. Flexible work arrangemen
